title: Brothers George and Joe; band hometown hospitality
summary: Questions on his brother George's age and birthplace lead to Joe's youthful mischief and the band tradition of being entertained in each musician's home town.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah, George was older. George was born in Texas. He was born in 1900. My sister was born in 1902, I guess. She was still born in Texas. Both of them were born in Texas. We were the first ones born. They showed me where my birth-place was. My birth-place was on a street called Fond-Du-Lac(?). But my family, I don't know how they got that home.
You know, I have never been to your house, to your home in Oklahoma.
Yeah. Well, you know, that's a thing we had in the band, you know. Any time you got to your home town, you were entertained.
And Frazier's... Frazier was before you were in the band. Frazier's father was an insurance man. He was from Memphis. Well, we'll get to that later on.
We'll get to that. So when did Joe first...?
Joe went to the same school I did. He was....

Yeah. My brother was kind of a bad boy when he was younger. Boy, he got into... I missed all that. Because they got into... They would steal a car, and he'd just drive it somewhere and leave it. And they got into more mischief... Because some older students... Muskogee was one of the first towns there that had cars. I remember the Stanley Steamer. They never did find out how fast that car could go, because it was run by steam. I don't know what happened to it. But people had money. And a lot of them kids... (?)The thing to understand(?) about Oklahoma...
